material.locator: “Social protection” paragraphs 2–4; ILO Social Security (Minimum Standards) Convention, 1952 (No. 102), paragraph on nine life contingencies: health care, sickness, maternity, unemployment, disability, employment injury, old age, death of breadwinner and child maintenance.
material.description: Supports several cash/income-security and service areas, including health care, unemployment, family-related and life-cycle risks. The ILO page does not specifically substantiate housing as a category; that element relies on the OECD source and is not independently corroborated here.
